limitations: Development QEMU AArch64 fixtures, four vCPUs, new host-backed virtual NVMe disks.

Abrupt termination observes acknowledged term recovery and the ordinary durable-term advancement fixture; it does not independently check same-term vote retention across a VM crash, interrupted log/snapshot publication, or physical power loss.
Two guests exercise the native Raft-backed catalog, remote invocation and generation-fenced unregister; they do not join a Java/C++/Rust TCP cluster.
No simultaneous multi-voter restart, storage fault injection, new TLA+ execution, throughput or management TLS availability qualification.

abrupt_recovery.limitation: QEMU process loss with a host-backed virtual NVMe disk; not physical power-loss qualification

interrupt_guard: The kernel fixture emits the matched first-term line only after stage >= 6, leader state, term > 0, and durable == 1.
